lines: 第二十六章你快要死了
“如果叶欢先生嫌麻烦的话，我们可以帮你发表，署名自然还是你，只是在身份一栏上加上我们林城大学物理学院的客座教授就好。”
“可以，就照你说的办吧。还有，就叫我叶欢就好了。”叶欢也无所谓，这种公式，他随便就能写下上百个。
刘玉权和其他教授对视了一眼，眼里都忍不住兴奋了。
有了叶欢的公式，他们物理学院这次在物理界可就出名了。
说不定，林城大学排名也会增加，迈入全国前十。
商量好这些事后，叶欢客座教授身份也就确定了。
接下来就是课程安排和教授福利待遇，这些叶欢都无所谓，随意的答应了下来。
安排后以后叶欢就离开林城大学了，他是客座教授，不用一直待在学校。
本来叶欢学校是会给客座教授分配住宿的，但叶欢需要修炼，也就拒绝了。
随意在学校外找了一家普通的宾馆，他现在身上也只有三千块，住不起太好的宾馆。
其实叶欢找宾馆也不是用来睡觉的，他只是洗漱了一番，将自己的背包和小狼放在宾馆里。
晚上，叶欢便来到了林城大学，这里的灵气很浓郁，很适合修炼。
林城大学很大，植被浓郁，所以灵气相对比城市里其他地方灵气浓厚多了。
叶欢来到一个湖畔旁，现在虽然已经是晚上了，但还是有一些情侣在这里亲热。
这里是灵气最浓郁的地方，而且也没有路灯，很适合修炼。
叶欢找了一个干净的地方，盘坐开始修炼起来。
“这个人在干什么？怎么就坐在地上了？”
“不知道，神经病吧……”
不过还是有情侣注意道叶欢了，把他的行为当做了神经病，吓得赶紧离开了。
其他情侣也陆陆续续注意到叶欢，都悄悄地离开了。
这里没有路灯，遇到这么个怪人，还真有些害怕。
叶欢自然不在意别人的看法，沉浸在修炼之中。
这里的灵气还算不错，对于现在的叶欢而言还能够接受。
不过如果他修为在精进一些，这种程度的修炼浓度就对他几乎没有了。
等叶欢睁开眼，已经是早上6点了，不过这个湖在林城大学比较偏远的地方，所以还没见什么大学生路过。
不过叶欢倒是看到一老一少这里练拳。老的是一位穿着白衫的老者，时不时的指点一旁的少女一二。
少女同样是一身白色的练功装，但身材高挑，皮肤细腻雪白，竟是一位难得一见的美女。
叶欢站了起来，淡淡一笑，这些普通的招式，在他看来，练再多也无用。
随意看了一眼，叶欢就收回了目光，即便对方是难得一见的美女，他也不会多看一眼。
这时，那白衣女孩却走了过来，俏脸冰冷，好像颇为不服气。
“喂，你笑什么？难道我们打拳很搞笑吗？”
赵月夕早就看到叶欢了，她和爷爷经常来这里练拳，没想到今天一来就遇到一个坐在这里的怪人。
本来赵月夕还以为是个神经病或者流浪汉，没想到爷爷却说这可能是位好人。莫要轻易招惹。
她仔细一打量这个人，发现眉清目秀，还有种特别让人舒服的气质。
可是，这么年轻的一个人，怎么可能是什么高人。
肯定连自己打不过，她可是练拳十几年了。
赵月夕本来就不服气，看到叶欢的笑容更是气不过，所以才走过来。
“抱歉，无意冒犯。”叶欢也懒得和这种普通少女争执。
叶欢这样一说，赵月夕反倒有些不好意思了。

Chapter 26 You are dying
"If Mr. Ye Huan finds it troublesome, we can help you publish it. The signature will naturally be yours. Just add our visiting professor at the School of Physics of Lincheng University in the identity column."
"Okay, just do as you say. Also, just call me Ye Huan." Ye Huan didn't care. He could easily write down hundreds of such formulas.
Liu Yuquan and the other professors looked at each other, their eyes couldn't help but be excited.
With Ye Huan's formula, their School of Physics has become famous in the physics community this time.
Maybe Lincheng University’s ranking will also increase and enter the top ten in the country.
After discussing these matters, Ye Huan's status as visiting professor was confirmed.
The next step was the course arrangement and professor's benefits. Ye Huan didn't care about these and agreed casually.
After the arrangement, Ye Huan left Lincheng University. He was a visiting professor and did not have to stay at the school all the time.
Originally, Ye Huan's school would allocate accommodation to the visiting professor, but Ye Huan needed to practice, so he refused.
He randomly found an ordinary hotel outside the school. He only had 3,000 yuan on his money and could not afford to stay in a very good hotel.
In fact, Ye Huan didn't find the hotel to sleep. He just washed up and put his backpack and Xiaolang in the hotel.
In the evening, Ye Huan came to Lincheng University. The aura here was very rich and very suitable for cultivation.
Lincheng University is very large and has rich vegetation, so the aura is much stronger than other places in the city.
Ye Huan came to a lakeside. Although it was already night, there were still some couples making out there.
This is the place with the strongest spiritual energy, and there are no street lights, so it is very suitable for cultivation.
Ye Huan found a clean place, sat cross-legged and began to practice.
"What is this person doing? Why is he sitting on the ground?"
"I don't know, maybe I'm crazy..."
However, some lovers still noticed Ye Huan, mistook his behavior for a lunatic, and left quickly in fright.
Other couples also noticed Ye Huan one after another and left quietly.
There are no street lights here, so I was really scared to meet such a weirdo.
Ye Huan naturally didn't care about other people's opinions and immersed himself in cultivation.
The spiritual energy here is quite good, and it is acceptable to Ye Huan now.
However, if he improves his cultivation, this level of concentration will be almost useless to him.
When Ye Huan opened his eyes, it was already 6 o'clock in the morning, but the lake was in a relatively remote area of ​​Lincheng University, so he hadn't seen any college students passing by yet.
However, Ye Huan saw an old man and a young man practicing boxing here. The old man was an old man wearing a white shirt, and from time to time he gave pointers to the girl beside him.
The girl is also wearing white training clothes, but she is tall and has delicate white skin. She is actually a rare beauty.
Ye Huan stood up and smiled faintly. In his opinion, these ordinary moves were useless no matter how much he practiced.
After a casual glance, Ye Huan withdrew his gaze. Even if the other person was a rare beauty, he would not look at her twice.
At this time, the girl in white came over, her pretty face was cold, and she seemed quite unconvinced.
"Hey, why are you laughing? Isn't our boxing funny?"
Zhao Yuexi had seen Ye Huan a long time ago. She and her grandfather often came here to practice boxing. Unexpectedly, she met a strange man sitting here when she came today.
Initially, Zhao Yuexi thought he was a lunatic or a homeless man, but her grandfather said that he might be a good person. Don't mess with it easily.
She looked at this person carefully and found that he had delicate features and a particularly comfortable aura.
However, how could such a young person be an expert?
She definitely can't even beat herself. She has been practicing boxing for more than ten years.
Zhao Yuexi was not convinced at first, but she was even more angry when she saw Ye Huan's smile, so she came over.
"Sorry, no offense intended." Ye Huan was too lazy to argue with such an ordinary girl.
When Ye Huan said this, Zhao Yuexi felt a little embarrassed.
